library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scater)
library(zellkonverter)
library(ggplot2)
library(aricode)
library(mclust)
library(clevr)
library(patchwork)

mouse_sce <- readH5AD("mouse_uniform.h5ad")
human_sce <- readH5AD("human_test_sample_2.h5ad")

mouse_seurat <- as.Seurat(mouse_sce, counts = NULL, data = "X")
human_seurat <- as.Seurat(human_sce, counts = NULL, data = "X")

mouse_seurat$celltype <- mouse_sce$cell_type

rm(mouse_sce, human_sce)
gc()

mouse_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(mouse_seurat)
human_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(human_seurat)

mouse_seurat <- ScaleData(mouse_seurat)
human_seurat <- ScaleData(human_seurat)

mouse_seurat <- RunPCA(mouse_seurat, npcs = 50)
human_seurat <- RunPCA(human_seurat, npcs = 50)

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(
  object.list = list(mouse_seurat, human_seurat),
  nfeatures = 1200)

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = mouse_seurat,
  query = human_seurat,
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  features = features,
  k.anchor = 10,
  k.filter = 200,
  k.score = 50)

pred <- TransferData(
  anchorset = anchors,
  refdata = mouse_seurat$celltype,
  dims = 1:30)

human_seurat$predicted_celltype <- pred$predicted.id
human_seurat <- RunUMAP(human_seurat, dims = 1:30)
p1 <- DimPlot(human_seurat, group.by = "predicted_celltype", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Seurat Label Transfer Predictions")
p2 <- DimPlot(human_seurat, group.by = "cell_type", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("True Human Cell Types")

print(p1 | p2) 

true_labels <- human_seurat$cell_type
pred_labels <- human_seurat$predicted_celltype
cm <- table(True = true_labels, Predicted = pred_labels)

classes <- intersect(unique(true_labels), unique(pred_labels))

precision <- sapply(classes, function(lbl) {
  tp <- sum(true_labels == lbl & pred_labels == lbl)
  fp <- sum(true_labels != lbl & pred_labels == lbl)
  if (tp + fp == 0) return(NA_real_)
  tp / (tp + fp)})

recall <- sapply(classes, function(lbl) {
  tp <- sum(true_labels == lbl & pred_labels == lbl)
  fn <- sum(true_labels == lbl & pred_labels != lbl)
  if (tp + fn == 0) return(NA_real_)
  tp / (tp + fn)})

f1 <- 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

# metrics 

f1_table <- data.frame(CellType = classes,
  Precision = precision,
  Recall = recall,
  F1 = f1)
testing_accuracy <- mean(pred_labels == true_labels)
homogeneity <- homogeneity(true_labels, pred_labels)
ari <- adjustedRandIndex(true_labels, pred_labels)
nmi <- NMI(true_labels, pred_labels)
metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Testing Accuracy", "Homogeneity", "ARI", "NMI"),
  Value = c(testing_accuracy, homogeneity, ari, nmi))
print(metrics)
write.csv(metrics, "results/transfer_metrics.csv")

cell_counts <- table(true_labels)

common_classes <- intersect(names(cell_counts), names(f1))

weights <- cell_counts[common_classes] / sum(cell_counts)

weighted_f1 <- sum(f1[common_classes] * weights, na.rm = TRUE)
print(weighted_f1)

cm_df <- as.data.frame(cm)
colnames(cm_df) <- c("True", "Predicted", "Count")

cm_prop <- prop.table(cm, margin = 1)
cm_prop_df <- as.data.frame(cm_prop)
colnames(cm_prop_df) <- c("True", "Predicted", "Prop")

cm_df$True <- factor(cm_df$True, levels = rownames(cm))
cm_df$Predicted <- factor(cm_df$Predicted, levels = colnames(cm))
cm_prop_df$True <- factor(cm_prop_df$True, levels = rownames(cm))
cm_prop_df$Predicted <- factor(cm_prop_df$Predicted, levels = colnames(cm))

p_counts <- ggplot(cm_df, aes(x = Predicted, y = True, fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix (Counts)", x = "Predicted", y = "True", fill = "Count")

p_prop <- ggplot(cm_prop_df, aes(x = Predicted, y = True, fill = Prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * Prop)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix (Row %)", x = "Predicted", y = "True", fill = "Row %")

print(p_counts)
print(p_prop)
